Starter notebook templates for jupyter
Provisions a small set of starter .ipynb files into the workspace
volume at deploy time so a fresh JupyterLab pod has runnable
examples on first open. Data-only — no packages, no services. The
data: block copies candy/notebook-templates/data/notebooks/
into the volume's root; consumers (jupyter, jupyter-ml) compose
this layer to ship the templates.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| Intent | Step |
|---|---|
| `check` | workspace volume is mounted as a directory at the canonical path |
| `check` | at least one .ipynb starter template is present in that workspace |
